observed_defects.finding: Duplicate virtual 3D geometry stage in rendered pipeline.
Hopf map S3-to-S2 and stereographic projection were not separated clearly enough.

Authority/Mirror pole placement was not explicitly labelled as a QIK-VRT model mapping.
The displayed processing chain omitted an explicit VERIFY/REVIEW stage before acceptance.
Reproducibility language exceeded the actual review state of the generated PNG.
